_about: How a restaurant day runs. One day per real day, starting at 5 AM local (GameClock.DAY_STARTS_AT_HOUR). Every day opens at the first phase, whatever the time. Each phase has a set list of customers, planned once a day: walk_ins townsfolk plus some of the day's regulars (regulars_per_day in regulars.json, spread across the phases). When everyone in a phase is done, a player rings the bell at the counter for the next one; after the last, the restaurant closes (big moment scenes play then) and stays closed until tomorrow. arrival_seconds: the gap between customers walking in. lighting: the sun's color and energy, the ambient light, and the sky color, faded in as the phase starts. 'closing' is the lighting after the last phase. Once the phone is on the wall, the night shift follows closing: chairs up, no walk-ins, phone orders only (see data/phone.json 'night'); 'night' is its name and lighting.
